intent: B1 of the final-release programme (org/plans/2026-09-final-release.md): security and truth. requireAuthenticatedHostWrites() first in POST /api/scripts/run and POST /api/update, with the host-side-effect paths listed in src/proxy.ts's PS_AUTH_MODE=none branch (D42, D123); recursive api_key masking in GET /api/config (D74); the three writing GETs skip their writes under PS_READ_ONLY (D124); fast-mode chat sends Authorization and stops double-counting (D44, D45); PS_COMPOSER guard on the composer SSE route (D5); one failure envelope for every sync endpoint via answerSingle/answerBatch (D125, D19, D11, D20); the second mission-cancel implementation deleted and the events route aborting upstream on disconnect (D128, D127); the deploy API honest and live by default, decision 17 (D53, D105, D107, D108, D111); install.sh Reinstall backs the database up and asks for a typed confirmation (D106); --color-neon-red declared with a token-must-exist design-lint rule (D114, D115); API.md pinned to the route tree by a test (D129).

reasons.evidence: src/proxy.ts and the host-write guards are touched

invariants: I1 A write that reaches the host (script save, script run, crontab line, deploy spawn) is refused under PS_AUTH_MODE=none twice: by the proxy from a list, and by the route itself. Reads beside them keep answering, and an ordinary write still passes, because auth mode none is not read-only.
I2 No API key leaves GET /api/config in plaintext at any depth, in any array.
I3 A GET answers under PS_READ_ONLY and writes nothing; the three that used to write say why they may consult the mode, on the line above, in the words the linter accepts.

I4 A sync endpoint's answer carries the outcome it had: a failed single target is a 500 naming target and reason; a batch with failures is a 200 whose data says so and names each; a client reads the body rather than assuming from the status.

I5 The deploy block never paints a state it has not verified: a failed version check is a warning, the deploy API being off is said before the click, a deploy that never ends releases the buttons after the cap.
I6 A house colour class without a declared token is a red build.
commits: 9696dc87 the oracle alone (14 suites, 60 failing assertions, measured red); 91134b70 the implementation (48 files); 35388a56 the sharpened lint oracle the sweep demanded.
deviation: The plan said the two answer helpers lift into profile-sync-shared.ts. They live in a new sibling, src/modules/hermes/lib/sync-answer.ts, because profile-sync-shared.ts is the filesystem floor of the sync halves and an HTTP answer does not belong in it; every route that answers a sync goes through the new file, which is the plan's intent.
verification: Gate on 91134b70 by exit code: lint 0 (doc-links, derived views 113, read-only guards 165 handlers across 99 route files, icon-button names 78/0, form-control names 100/0, design-lint 0 baselined, contrast 4 tiers, coverage floors held, eslint, typecheck:tests), tsc 0, jest 0 (3985 tests, 457 suites), knip 0, canary OK (httpSurface unchanged: no route added or removed), build 0, Playwright 91 passed, 0 failed, 8 skipped. The sharpening commit re-gated its own suites, design-lint, typecheck:tests and knip. Shell harness on this Windows machine: the two new sections pass (5 checks: if-absent leaves a value, writes a missing key; reinstall refuses 'y', moves the data dir aside and says where, removes when there is no data dir); the harness then dies in the pre-existing ps-backup section on a symlink this Git Bash cannot make, which is environment and is why the new sections were placed ahead of it. CI runs the whole harness on ubuntu.
mutation: 40 mutants against the committed tree, 40 killed after one round. The survivor of the first pass: a scanTree that silently skipped the predicate rule still passed 'token-must-exist lands at a zero baseline', because zero offenders and a blind rule look identical from outside; the per-file loop became violationsIn(path, lines) and the oracle plants a line the scan must report (35388a56). The first re-run of that mutant reported 'killed' falsely, against a tree whose sharpened oracle was uncommitted: the sweep's own git checkout restored the committed file underneath the test, which then failed on a missing export rather than on the mutant. Re-run after the commit: killed for the right reason.
proof: Isolated instance (production build, e2e-b1 data dir, mock-hermes 8747, mock-hindsight 9277), four server modes: (1) NODE_ENV=production with the flag unset: GET /api/config no longer carries the fixture's fallback-provider key (masked to sk-f••••cdef), GET /api/update?deploy=1 carries deployEnabled:false, GET /api/status/subsystems answers, the footer reads 'Deploy API is off (PS_ENABLE_DEPLOY_API=false in .env.local)' with Check for Updates disabled before any click, text-neon-red resolves to rgb(248, 113, 113); (2) PS_ENABLE_DEPLOY_API=true: deployEnabled:true, no off line, Check enabled; (3) PS_AUTH_MODE=none: POST /api/scripts/run 403, POST /api/update 403, PUT /api/scripts/pwn.sh 403, GET /api/scripts 200 with no token, POST /api/missions 201; (4) PS_READ_ONLY=1: GET /api/stats 200, GET /api/sessions 200, GET .../default/toolsets 200, a write 503. Screenshot: scratchpad walk-b1/footer-deploy-off.png. One walk-script defect found and fixed on the way: process.exit() while undici sockets were closing tripped a libuv assertion on Windows and turned a passing phase into exit 1; process.exitCode instead.
harness_amendments: Three existing tests learned the new shape rather than the product bending to them: update-api.test.ts mocks the two new api-auth names; api-routes-simple.test.ts's paths mock gains the real readEnv (its GET /api/sessions had 500'd on a missing function unrelated to sessions); chat-failure-truth.test.ts hands the stream route a null request, which the route now tolerates. operation-sync-action.test.ts's success:false case was amended to the D20 contract (reload after a partial failure) in the oracle commit.
deferred: The full raw-red repaint (text-red-400 and friends onto semantic-danger) stays deferred per the plan; token-must-exist covers house tokens only. The deploy buttons move to Settings > System in B3 (decision 12); this batch made the block honest where it stands.
